correctness.rationale: The 12 tetrahedral rotations form A4; the standard real rotation representation has character 3 on identity, -1 on three half-turns and 0 on eight order-three elements. Its matrix coefficients plus constants form 10D Wigner degree0+1 subspace, with full-group normalized Haar/counting isometry. The image projector has P_{gh}=(1+3chi(g^-1 h))/12, diagonal 5/6 and off diagonal -1/6 (half-turn) or 1/12 (3-cycle). Erasing two nodes gives I-R_E^*R_E, whose two nonunit eigenvalues are 1-(5/6±P_{gh}); these are 0,1/3 for half-turn and 1/12,1/4 for order three, with eight unit eigenvalues. Exactly 12*3/2=18 halfturn and 12*8/2=48 order-three unordered pairs; unit-weights fixed at 1/12. Independently enumerated all even permutations, verified exact rational projector idempotence on 12x12, all 66 classifications and spectra, plus one-erasure eigenvalue 1/6. The explicit delta-supported half-turn witness follows from the character difference and matches the continuous trace formula. Exact representation/projection proof covers every pair, with exhaustive finite computation as cross-check.
